workItems.note: The spine: the persistent mode rail, the course frame, and the rule that a live assessment takes the whole screen.
FIRST, by explicit instruction. The reader: the lesson body, its contents panel, the on-this-page outline, the pager, and the paywall boundary.
Flashcards, foundations, mind-map, playground, qa, mock-interview, personal-project, leaderboard, headhuntings. Each is its own later case; this record only fixes where they hang.

evidence: learn/page.tsx redirects to learn/content, so the reader is the legacy home
LearnShellLayout decides rails per segment: content and modules get a resizable left content map plus a right on-this-page outline
isAssessmentLive flags a live quiz or interview apart from its own mode
ENROLL_REQUIRED_SURFACES gates only personal-project; trial viewers browse the rest

unknowns: Whether the four groups of the spine are the product's own words or this case's invention - the legacy repository groups nothing, it lists segments
Whether the contents panel keeps the legacy resizable rail behaviour or becomes a fixed measure
Whether trial viewers see the spine's gated entries at all, or see them marked

directions.thesis: Keep the legacy shape exactly: the reader is home, its contents rail sits left, the outline sits right, and every other mode is a peer on one horizontal run.
tradeoffs: Nine peers on one row means the ninth is never seen

directions.thesis: The eleven modes are not eleven peers - they are learn, practise, prove and community. One persistent left spine carries them grouped, and the lesson's own contents drop to a second-level panel inside the reader.
directions.primaryCta: Continue reading, or the mode's own first action
readingOrder: second-level panel where the mode has one
tradeoffs: The spine takes width from the reader on narrow screens
Grouping is a claim about what the modes are FOR, and the legacy repository never made that claim
legacyDivergence: The contents panel moves from a persistent rail to a second-level panel inside the reader
Modes are grouped rather than listed

exactProposals: A spine entry grouping rows under a heading: inventory first against marked-row-list plus label-row-over-card before any new key
A rail-then-main page frame: inventory first against the existing rail layouts, which already express md:[&>*:first-child]:w-72 and its sticky twin

directions.thesis: The course home is what to do today - continue reading, cards due, a challenge waiting, a milestone - and the reader is one destination among several.
tradeoffs: A returning reader pays one extra press every day to reach the thing they came for
legacyDivergence: /learn stops being an alias for the reader
